points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 1588年4月5日，霍布斯出生于英格兰威尔士的马尔特姆，父亲是当地一位牧师。由于家庭贫困，霍布斯自幼由叔父抚养。1603年，他进入牛津大学莫德林学院学习，主修古典文学和哲学。这段时期，霍布斯接受了传统的经院哲学教育，但同时也开始接触人文主义思想，为他后来的政治哲学奠定了基础。1608年，霍布斯毕业后成为卡文迪什家族的家庭教师，开始了他的职业生涯。
points.descriptionEn: Born on April 5, 1588, in Malmesbury, Wiltshire, England, Thomas Hobbes came from a modest background as the son of a local clergyman. Due to family financial difficulties, he was raised by his uncle. In 1603, Hobbes entered Magdalen College, Oxford, where he studied classical literature and philosophy. During this period, he received traditional scholastic education but also began to encounter humanist ideas that would later form the foundation of his political philosophy. After graduating in 1608, Hobbes became a tutor to the Cavendish family, beginning his professional career.

points.title: 大陆游历
points.description: 1610年至1628年间，霍布斯作为家庭教师陪同卡文迪什家族多次游历欧洲大陆，特别是法国和意大利。这段经历使他接触到伽利略、笛卡尔等科学家的思想，以及欧洲大陆的政治现实。在巴黎，霍布斯结识了伽利略，深受其科学方法影响。他还研究了欧几里得几何学，并将其作为理性思考的典范。这些经历极大地拓展了霍布斯的视野，使他开始思考政治权力的本质和基础，为他后来的政治哲学创作积累了素材和思想资源。
points.descriptionEn: Between 1610 and 1628, Hobbes accompanied the Cavendish family on several tours of the European continent, particularly France and Italy. During this period, he was exposed to the ideas of scientists like Galileo and Descartes, as well as the political realities of continental Europe. In Paris, Hobbes met Galileo and was deeply influenced by his scientific methods. He also studied Euclidean geometry, which he came to see as a model for rational thought. These experiences greatly broadened Hobbes' horizons and led him to begin contemplating the nature and foundation of political power, accumulating material and intellectual resources for his later political philosophy.

points.title: 政治观察
points.description: 1629年回到伦敦后，霍布斯积极参与英国的政治生活，成为国王查理一世的顾问。他目睹了英国议会与国王之间的紧张关系，以及日益加剧的政治冲突。1636年，霍布斯完成了他的第一部重要著作《论公民》，但未立即出版。这一时期，霍布斯开始系统思考政治权力的基础和社会契约理论。他认识到，在缺乏强大中央权威的情况下，社会将陷入'所有人对所有人的战争'状态。这些观察和思考为他的代表作《利维坦》奠定了基础，也使他对英国的政治局势感到忧虑。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to London in 1629, Hobbes actively participated in English political life, becoming an advisor to King Charles I. He witnessed the growing tension between the English Parliament and the monarchy, as well as the escalating political conflicts. In 1636, Hobbes completed his first major work, 'De Cive' (On the Citizen), though it was not immediately published. During this period, Hobbes began systematically contemplating the foundations of political power and social contract theory. He recognized that without a strong central authority, society would descend into a 'war of all against all.' These observations and reflections laid the groundwork for his masterpiece 'Leviathan' and made him increasingly concerned about England's political situation.

points.title: 流亡创作
points.description: 1640年，随着英国内战临近，霍布斯因支持国王而被迫流亡巴黎。在巴黎期间，他加入了英国流亡者社区，与笛卡尔等哲学家交流。1642年，他出版了《论公民》，阐述了他的政治哲学基本观点。1649年，查理一世被处决后，霍布斯开始创作他最重要的著作《利维坦》。这部作品于1651年在伦敦出版，但霍布斯直到1652年才返回英国。《利维坦》系统阐述了霍布斯的社会契约理论，认为人们为了摆脱自然状态的恐惧，同意放弃部分自由，建立主权国家。这部作品奠定了现代政治哲学的基础，也使霍布斯成为西方政治思想史上的重要人物。
points.descriptionEn: As the English Civil War approached in 1640, Hobbes was forced into exile in Paris for his royalist sympathies. In Paris, he joined the community of English exiles and engaged with philosophers like Descartes. In 1642, he published 'De Cive' (On the Citizen), outlining his basic political philosophy. After the execution of Charles I in 1649, Hobbes began writing his most important work, 'Leviathan,' which was published in London in 1651, though Hobbes did not return to England until 1652. 'Leviathan' systematically presented Hobbes' social contract theory, arguing that people agree to surrender some freedom to escape the fear of the state of nature, thereby establishing sovereign states. This work laid the foundation of modern political philosophy and established Hobbes as a significant figure in the history of Western political thought.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 1652年回到伦敦后，霍布斯继续他的学术创作，完成了多部重要著作，包括《论物体》(1655)、《论人》(1658)等。这些作品进一步完善了他的哲学体系。霍布斯的晚年生活相对平静，但他仍然面临来自宗教和学术界的批评。1666年，英国议会通过法案禁止讨论无神论和君主制问题，这对霍布斯的哲学构成了挑战。尽管如此，霍布斯仍然坚持自己的观点，直到1679年12月4日在德比郡去世，享年91岁。霍布斯的哲学思想，特别是他对社会契约和国家主权的论述，对后世政治哲学产生了深远影响，成为现代政治理论的重要基石。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to London in 1652, Hobbes continued his academic work, completing several important works including 'De Corpore' (On Body, 1655) and 'De Homine' (On Man, 1658), which further developed his philosophical system. Hobbes' later life was relatively peaceful, though he continued to face criticism from religious and academic circles. In 1666, the English Parliament passed an act prohibiting discussions of atheism and monarchy, posing challenges to Hobbes' philosophy. Nevertheless, Hobbes remained steadfast in his views until his death on December 4, 1679, in Derbyshire at the age of 91. Hobbes' philosophical ideas, particularly his theories of social contract and sovereignty, had a profound influence on later political philosophy and became an important cornerstone of modern political theory.

supporter.zh: 霍布斯被视为现代政治哲学的奠基人之一，他的社会契约理论为理解国家权力的合法性提供了重要框架。支持者认为霍布斯通过理性分析，揭示了人类社会的本质需求，即为了安全和秩序，人们愿意放弃部分自由。他的《利维坦》强调了主权国家在维护社会秩序中的核心作用，这一思想对现代国家理论产生了深远影响。霍布斯还推动了科学方法在哲学中的应用，强调逻辑和数学在理解社会现象中的重要性，为后来的实证主义哲学奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Hobbes is regarded as one of the founders of modern political philosophy, and his social contract theory provides an important framework for understanding the legitimacy of state power. Supporters argue that through rational analysis, Hobbes revealed the essential needs of human society—people's willingness to surrender some freedom for security and order. His 'Leviathan' emphasized the central role of sovereign states in maintaining social order, an idea that profoundly influenced modern state theory. Hobbes also promoted the application of scientific methods in philosophy, emphasizing the importance of logic and mathematics in understanding social phenomena, laying the foundation for later positivist philosophy.

critic.zh: 批评者认为霍布斯的政治理论过于强调权威而忽视了个人自由的价值。他的'利维坦'概念被指责为为专制统治提供了理论辩护，忽视了权力制衡的重要性。霍布斯对人性的悲观看法也受到质疑，认为他低估了人类的合作能力和道德感。此外，他的理论被认为缺乏对宗教和道德因素的足够重视，将政治简化为纯粹的利益计算。批评者还指出，霍布斯的理论在解释民主制度和公民权利方面存在局限性，难以适应现代多元社会的需求。
critic.en: Critics argue that Hobbes' political theory overemphasizes authority while neglecting the value of individual freedom. His concept of the 'Leviathan' is accused of providing theoretical justification for authoritarian rule, neglecting the importance of checks and balances. Hobbes' pessimistic view of human nature has also been questioned, with critics arguing that he underestimated humanity's capacity for cooperation and moral sense. Additionally, his theory is considered to lack sufficient attention to religious and moral factors, reducing politics to mere calculation of interests. Critics also point out that Hobbes' theory has limitations in explaining democratic systems and civil rights, making it difficult to adapt to the needs of modern pluralistic societies.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，霍布斯被公认为西方政治思想史上的关键人物，他的社会契约理论影响了洛克、卢梭等后世思想家。在流行文化中，'霍布斯式选择'已成为描述人们在极端情况下为求生存而放弃自由的常用术语。霍布斯的哲学思想体现了17世纪科学革命对人文思想的影响，他将几何学方法应用于政治哲学，开创了理性主义政治理论的传统。尽管他的具体政治主张在现代民主社会中有争议，但他对国家权力基础的分析和对社会契约的论述，仍然是政治哲学讨论的重要起点，体现了西方政治思想中关于自由与秩序永恒张力的重要维度。
objective.en: In academic circles, Hobbes is recognized as a pivotal figure in the history of Western political thought, and his social contract theory influenced later thinkers such as Locke and Rousseau. In popular culture, the 'Hobbesian choice' has become a common term describing people's abandonment of freedom for survival in extreme situations. Hobbes' philosophical philosophy reflects the impact of the Scientific Revolution on humanistic thought in the 17th century. He applied geometric methods to political philosophy, pioneering the tradition of rationalist political theory. Although his specific political proposals are controversial in modern democratic societies, his analysis of the foundations of state power and his discussion of social contract remain important starting points for political philosophy discussions, embodying the enduring tension between freedom and order in Western political thought.

self.zh: 在自然状态下，没有共同权力存在的地方，就没有法律；没有法律的地方，就没有正义。
self.en: Where there is no common power, there is no law; where no law, no injustice.

others.zh: 霍布斯是第一个将政治哲学建立在人类本性而非神意基础上的思想家，他使政治学成为一门科学。
others.en: Hobbes was the first thinker to base political philosophy on human nature rather than divine will, making politics a science.
